subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Vaginal discharge and STIs: clue cells, froth, ulcers and warts

steps.tx: **Bacterial vaginosis** from Gardnerella with anaerobes gives thin grey homogenous discharge with pH over 4.5, fishy **whiff test** positivity on KOH and **clue cells** on wet mount, while douching raises risk. Metronidazole 400 for 7 days or 2 g single dose, or clindamycin, cures most cases, and pregnancy needs treatment to cut preterm risk. **Trichomoniasis** brings frothy yellow green discharge with strawberry cervix and motile flagellates, and it needs metronidazole 2 g single dose for both partners. Recurrence follows biofilm or re exposure and needs retreatment.
steps.say: Bacterial vaginosis coats cells with bacteria and releases a fishy odour on testing. Thin grey discharge with raised pH confirms the diagnosis under the microscope. Metronidazole is the cure for most cases, and pregnancy deserves treatment because infection threatens preterm birth. Frothy discharge with a strawberry cervix signals trichomoniasis, and it needs treatment of both partners.

steps.tx: The illustration pairs wet mount microscopy studded with **clue cells** against icons for thin grey discharge, pH strip over 4.5 and a positive **whiff test**, closing with a **metronidazole** bottle. Clue cells are vaginal epithelial cells coated with bacteria, and together with raised pH and fishy odour they diagnose bacterial vaginosis at the bedside. For the exam, match this triad to metronidazole treatment and remember that trichomoniasis instead shows frothy discharge with a strawberry cervix. The image fixes microscopy beside clinical tests for rapid recall.
steps.say: The panel shows microscopy crowded with clue cells beside bedside test icons. A pH strip reads raised values while the whiff test releases a fishy smell. Thin grey discharge is the finding that completes the clinical picture of bacterial vaginosis. Metronidazole cures the condition, so examiners link this visual triad to that prescription.

steps.tx: **Vulvovaginal candidiasis** gives intensely itchy curdy white discharge with pseudohyphae on KOH, favoured by diabetes, pregnancy and antibiotics. **Fluconazole** 150 mg single dose or clotrimazole pessary cures simple cases, while **recurrent infection** with 4 episodes in 6 months needs maintenance therapy and sugar control in diabetics. Atrophic discharge looks pale and dry after menopause and responds to estrogen cream, while physiologic discharge runs clear at midcycle and milky in pregnancy. Douching worsens every discharge and needs firm discouragement.
steps.say: Candida causes intense itching with thick curdy discharge in diabetics and pregnant mothers. A single fluconazole dose cures simple cases while repeated attacks need longer maintenance. Pale dry discharge after menopause is treated with estrogen cream. Clear midcycle fluid and milky pregnancy discharge remain normal, so douching only harms.

steps.tx: **Syphilis** opens with a painless chancre showing spirochaetes on dark ground microscopy, then palmoplantar rash with condyloma lata. Screening uses VDRL or RPR with TPHA confirmation, and early disease needs **benzathine penicillin** 2.4 MU single dose while neurosyphilis needs intravenous penicillin, with fever heralding the Jarisch reaction. **Chancroid** gives a painful soft sore with bubo from Haemophilus and responds to azithromycin. Donovanosis bleeds beefily and LGV shows a groove sign, and both yield to doxycycline, with LGV needing 21 days.
steps.say: Syphilis begins with a painless sore and later spreads a rash across palms and soles. Blood screening confirms the diagnosis while benzathine penicillin cures early disease. A painful soft sore with a swollen gland points to chancroid instead. Beefy bleeding ulcers and grooved groin nodes complete the ulcer family, and they respond to their own antibiotics.

steps.tx: **Genital herpes** crops painful grouped vesicles that ulcerate, with multinucleated giant cells on Tzanck smear. Aciclovir treats episodes and suppresses from 36 weeks in pregnancy, while active lesions demand caesarean section. **Genital warts** form cauliflower growths from HPV 6 and 11, treated with cryotherapy, TCA or imiquimod, while podophyllin stays banned in pregnancy and **HPV vaccine** from 9 to 26 prevents disease. Gonorrhoea with chlamydia needs ceftriaxone plus doxycycline with partner treatment, since PID threatens fertility. Contact tracing with condoms contains spread.
steps.say: Herpes returns as painful grouped blisters that ulcerate and recur under stress. Aciclovir is given to calm episodes and suppress late pregnancy while active sores demand a caesarean section. Cauliflower warts respond to freezing or local therapy while vaccination prevents future cases. Urethral discharge needs dual antibiotics with partner therapy because untreated infection scars the tubes.
